name: sudoku_benchmark_variants
description: A collection of Sudoku puzzles and variant instances intended to benchmark algorithmic reasoning and solution-generation (often for RL or sequence models). Tasks require producing complete valid Sudoku solutions given an initial partial grid, across multiple puzzle variants and difficulty levels.
typical_sota_score: varies by variant; classical solvers achieve ~100% while learned models range widely (roughly 50–95% depending on variant and model)
reputation: Niche benchmark used in algorithmic reasoning and RL communities; not as widely adopted as major supervised benchmarks.
